newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cementos Chihuahua H1 profit slips. [CORRECTED 18:20 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cementos Chihuahua H1 profit slips. [CORRECTED 18:20 GMT]

text.p: Mexico's Cementos Chihuahua said on Thursday its first half 1997 consolidated net profit was 64.1 million (corrects from "billion") pesos compared with 97.39 in the year-earlier period.
Sales increased by 12.3 percent to 627.4 million pesos from 558.55 million, the company said in a statement.
Operating profits totalled 128.5 million pesos for the first half of the year, down slightly from 134.86 million pesos recorded in the year-earlier period.
The company said cash flow during the first half of the year was 197.8 million pesos, up 4.5 percent from the first semester last year.
Integral financial costs totalled 27.9 million pesos, compared with an integrated financial gain of 10.45 million pesos the year before.
Of total sales, 46.7 percent were made in the U.S. market, the company added.
The company's U.S. sales were up 16.5 percent in dollar terms.
